description: This file contains styling definitions for a website's navigation bar (navbar), including layout, theming, responsiveness, and component-specific styles using SASS syntax. It defines CSS variables, layout behaviors, and responsive design patterns for various navbar elements like brand, nav links, toggler, and themes.
external_files: scss mixins such as gradient-bg(), font-size(), border-radius(), transition(), box-shadow(), color-mode(dark), etc.
